renderer: Direct3D 12 with hardware ray tracing (DXR 1.1 required)
binary: MetroExodus.exe (64-bit, Steam DRM wrapper section .bind; code not encrypted on disk)
summary: First unattended launch 2026-09-30 on a GTX 1660 SUPER: the game starts, a Win32 warning dialog must be dismissed with BM_CLICK on 'Run Anyway', the intros play, and a key press skips to the title screen. It then compiles shaders for about six minutes and crashes inside D3D12Core.dll. On a card without DXR 1.1 it never reaches the main menu, so nothing past the title screen has been tested.

working.route: Win32 dialogs ('System specification requirements not met', the BugTrap crash box): find the child button by its text and PostMessage BM_CLICK. UI Automation's Invoke found the text label, not the button.
SendInput with scancodes to the foreground game window: Space during the intro film ended it and moved on to the title screen.
working.note: One press, one observation. Whether it was Space or the film ending on its own is not separated.

states.warning_dialog: Title 'System specification requirements not met'; buttons Open Link / Quit / Run Anyway. Appears on any card without DXR 1.1.
states.intro: legal.webm then intro.webm, fullscreen 1920x1080 at 0,0 on first start.
states.title_loading: Metro Exodus key art with a small spinner at the bottom left. On first start it compiles shaders here (about 6 CPU cores busy).
states.crash_dialog: Title 'FATAL: MetroExodus', BugTrap. It writes a zip with a crash dump to Saved Games\Metro Exodus\ and sets the registry value HKCU\Software\4A-Games\Metro Exodus\BadQuit to 1.

hazards.claim: After a crash, BadQuit=1 makes the next start ask whether to start in safe mode; Yes lowers every graphics setting. Reset the value to 0 before relaunching unattended.
hazards.note: The value was measured as 1 after the crash; the safe-mode prompt itself comes from a static read and was not seen.

config.user_cfg: Saved Games\Metro Exodus\<steamid>\user.cfg is run as a console script at every start (static read). Windowing lines to try: r_fullscreen off, r_res_hor 1280, r_res_vert 720. There is no borderless setting and no command-line window switch. Untested live.
